Townhouse for Rent in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this beautifully designed 3-bedroom + maid’s townhouse from the exclusive Skylight Collection in Bliss 2, Arabian Ranches 3.

This premium home features a bright and spacious layout with elegant contemporary finishes and signature skylight design elements that allow abundant natural light throughout the property, creating a warm and modern living atmosphere.

Property Features:
3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
Skylight Collection Layout
Spacious Living & Dining Area
Modern Open Kitchen
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Private Garden
Covered Parking
Bright & Airy Interiors
Vacant / Ready to Move
Community Highlights:
Located in Bliss 2 – newest handover cluster in Arabian Ranches 3
Walking distance to pool, parks & kids play areas
Close to community center, supermarket & retail outlets
Family-friendly gated community with landscaped walkways

Bliss offers a unique urban village lifestyle with modern architecture, peaceful surroundings, and premium community living, making it one of the most desirable clusters in Arabian Ranches 3.
